verse.verse_1: By the sun and its midmorning,
verse.verse_2: by the moon, which follows it,
verse.verse_3: by the day, when it displays it,
verse.verse_4: by the night, when it envelops it!
verse.verse_5: By the heaven and Who built it,
verse.verse_6: by the earth and Who spread it,
verse.verse_7: by the soul and Who shaped it
verse.verse_8: and inspired it with its sin and its piety,
verse.verse_9: prosperous is he who purified it,
verse.verse_10: and failed is he who buried it!
verse.verse_12: when the most wicked of them broke forth,
verse.verse_13: the Messenger of Allah said to them: '(This is) the shecamel of Allah, let her drink'
verse.verse_14: But they belied him, and hamstrung her. So their Lord crushed them for their sin and leveled it (their village).
verse.verse_15: He does not fear the result (of their destruction).
